certification.notCertified: The ordering laws resting on `_private_experimental_ reorder to dos in` (ORD-1/2/3/7/8/9/12-HEADSORT/19/20/22) are recorded SUSPENDED, not confirmed: Things 3.23 accepts that command, exits 0, and produces a byte-empty delta. Their o-suite rows are green ONLY because version-conditional `expectFrom` overrides now assert that inertness — which makes the suite the behavioral canary the sdef declaration check cannot be. Two shipped reaches consequently have no surface on 3.23 and refuse honestly: heading order (`project move-heading`) and any day-group holding a repeating template.
